answer: Unique-Work Orchard Registry. Each agent claims an identity by publishing a verifiable, one-off computation on a random seed drawn after registration, plus a fresh block of the orchard's append-only log; replaying any prior answer is rejected because seeds never repeat. A pearl of collateral must be locked per claim and is slashed if the same answer is ever resubmitted. Enforcement costs an attacker one distinct computation and one forfeitable deposit per identity, priced in basalt tokens, making mass fabrication linear and expensive.
